st: Bassport to Lake Barrett: Top Bass Honey Hole
d: Michael Fowlkes & experienced bass anglers fish at Lake Barrett, a top spot in North San Diego County. Despite the weather, they catch fish & share tips to hook and reel them in. Packed with informative content & thrilling moments.

st: Hit the Water with Alaska's Deep Creek Fishing Club
d: Experience 5-star Alaska resort, Deep Creek Fishing Club. Fish with deluxe boats, secret spots, gourmet meals, top gear, expert guidance. Catch Halibut, Ling Cod and Yelloweye Grouper. Unforgettable adventure awaits!

st: Big Fishing in the Final Frontier
d: Experience 5-star fishing in Alaska with Deep Creek Fishing Club. Catch big fish like ling cod, yelloweye grouper, and octopus. Owners Steve and Vivian Moe provide top-notch accommodations, meals, and service. Steve, a top guide, shares expert techniques.

st: Swimming with 15 Ton Fish in Bahia de Los Angeles
d: Join Captain Ben Alexander and his crew as they explore Baja California Sur in Mexico. Experience fishing, swimming, diving, and snorkeling, and marvel at mesmerizing footage of girls swimming with whale sharks.

Father and son Dave and Adam Crouch team up to save a lorry transporting a train from sinking into soft ground. Crouch Recovery Op Jim has to rescue a lorry from a ditch after the driver attempted an ill-advised three-point turn.
Simon has to grapple with a juggernaut that has skidded off the M62 and down a steep bank, but when they finally manage to pull it back onto the carriageway, it starts leaking diesel.

A broken-down coach on a slip road of the motorway presents a major problem for Crouch recovery op Jon and Highways England. Recovery Op Marta and Tez work together to solve a serious weight issue on her trailer load.
Gary and Josh are frustrated by a series of breakdowns, while Claudia makes a shocking announcement that derails Robin's plans and causes conflict between the couple.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh, and Steve about how to mine, and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagued with truck troubles, Robin and his crew race to get a fuel run done before the equipment runs dry. Claudia hires Scrappy Larry to clean up the Jade City yard but he makes a bigger mess.
Robin clashes with Claudia and Josh over the quality of jade coming out of their pit, while Larry's attempt to help get the crew bunkhouse to camp goes sideways.
Bad brakes, frazzled nerves, and a rough road have Claudia doubting her crew can haul their huge bunkhouse to camp in one piece.
Claudia and crew are determined to keep mining despite wildfires burning around their claim until things take a turn for the worse and they have to race to get out.
Three survivors from the ill-fated UA Flight 232 relive the terrifying moments leading up to and after one of America's worst ever aviation disasters.

st: Sydney / Dr. Roger and Dena / Jennifer
d: Roger and Dena's home overlooking the San Pasqual Valley is everything they've ever dreamed of until Roger awakes one day to find a 40-foot wall of fire racing up the valley towards their house.
Two men remain on Vancouver Island as the storm of the year blows in.
The cast of Alone Season 2 reunites for the first time since leaving Vancouver Island to watch and discuss the 10 most talked-about moments of the series posted on social media.
Day three ends at Hurricane Hole Marina in Key West, Florida, on the Madfin Shark Series & there can be only one Madfin Shark Champion.

This week starts things off as Teams Blackjack, Yetti, Almost Famous, and Bear head out on the first morning with one team getting the first shark, but another taking a chance and having it pay off with an early lead.
This week, we finish up Day 1 as two teams land a bunch of sharks and rack up the points while the other two teams are still waiting for their first sharks.
As day 2 begins, teams are running into some bad luck as points are being lost across the board.
Day 2 continues as the four teams battle it out, but one team ends up taking a commanding lead heading into the third day.

The final day of the 7th Annual Madfin Shark Series begins and two teams make a radical and dangerous decision to travel over 100 miles north in a desperate reach for sharks to score final day points.
